name: Chat history, all chats deleted
summary: The end of the flow: the empty state with a toast counting what was removed, and New chat at the foot.

looseEnds.title: The whole nav goes after a bulk delete
looseEnds.detail: Back, Search and Select are all absent — the nav holds nothing but its own 393x124 frame. The single-chat delete frame keeps all three, so this is specific to deleting a selection and leaves the user with no drawn way off the page.
looseEnds.ask: Restore the nav after a bulk delete, or say what replaces it.

looseEnds.title: The toast carries an Undo that is switched off
looseEnds.detail: The Toast component has an Action slot holding the word Undo. It is hidden in this frame, as it is in every other delete toast across Chat history and Memory — so no drawn state offers a way back from a delete, although the component is built for one.
looseEnds.ask: Is Undo in scope? If it is, it needs a window and a drawn state; if it is not, the slot should come off the component so it stops reading as available.

looseEnds.title: The toast overlaps the empty state's heading area
looseEnds.detail: The toast sits at y=60 and the heading starts at y=146, so they do not collide — but the toast occupies the space the nav would, and with no Back button drawn there is nothing above the heading once it dismisses.
looseEnds.ask: Confirm what the user sees after the toast clears on this frame.
